elements.text:
These are my notes for exploring this space

- You build up your skills, you are at whatever level you are at currently. NEVER beat yourself up about it. It is incredibly inefficient in a logical sense, in an emotional sense acceptance is far superior. The rule also applies to itself.
- No Rationalization, just say things as they are. You don't have to defend yourself here.
- Be clear with yourself, and clarity for others will come. Sometimes that means figuring out which words actually mean what you want to say. A mis defined word can turn into self-deception.
- Logic approximates, emotions themselves do not. If your remembering just the logic about something you thought about, but not the emotion attached to it, you have lost information. This compounds and leads to "baseless" thoughts that have no bearing on reality, subjective or otherwise.
- Logic without a situation to apply it to makes no sense.
- Emotion ultimately makes most decisions
- Being prescriptive (what happens to me must be what its like for you) is never the default
- This is my mind, and I am not afraid to explore everything. "You should kill yourself" is advice I've given myself before. This map contains such things that cause instability in people, myself included. It mostly contains... other things.
- If you think these are rules I'm going to slap you.
- Permission is stronger than rules, rules perform well in low-trust situations, and constrict unnecessarily in high-trust situations. Trust the AI to output based on what you give it, trust it to be as "smart" as it is, then permissions can flow. Permission to be creative vs Be creative vs Don't be so logical.
- Good creative work is ferociously logical inside its own rules

Full understanding of these mental knowings/constrants is required to move forward. 
Also listening to the 2 intro songs at the beginning of meme land is compulsory
